private_runtime_protocol.registration: Add invocation-local registration of actual CODE references to the existing producer scope. Registration requires that actual SourceOrigins token and producer scope; retain strong references only until scope exit. Neither callback names, copied public contract/rule metadata nor equal values register anything. Existing explicit standalone producer-list scopes retain their behavior.
private_runtime_protocol.dependency: Every injected dependency call gets a separate private capture boundary. Scalar calls use the actual callback through the existing scalar capture primitive; preserve the ordinary actual value and error channel. List/void calls preserve their existing context and aliases under an isolated publication-disabled boundary, because the current packet protocol accepts scalar strings only. Do not coerce list/void calls into scalar capture.
private_runtime_protocol.binding: An optional private lexical thunk may call the boundary with the retained actual callback; it must not replace fields in caller-provided dependency maps or public default_deps results. Never clone/rebind a passed dependency/context map merely to install wrappers. If a private binding cannot prove these identities, instrument its actual call site.
private_runtime_protocol.known: Register fresh actual built-in contract lower callbacks at their own factory return. For dependency factories, only exact actual built-in callback references may register; a custom target or callback with the same public name stays opaque. Preserve public callback fields and ordinary contracts/rules. Retaining an already registered actual callback selects only that callback in its own scope; copied metadata itself grants nothing.
private_runtime_protocol.composition: A scalar invocation boundary does not implicitly transfer a child publication into its parent. Later trusted output builders must retain the actual child capture and explicitly compose its packet, using the existing identity getter. No output-text lookup, equal-value cache or raw search.
private_runtime_protocol.activation: After individual owners are verified, nest producer and input scopes inside the existing SourceOrigins invocation before factories run. Capture each actual canonical apply callback in scalar context without changing its public reference, arguments, event/context identity, family order, text replacement behavior or diagnostics.
